map.算法：日剂量 = 体重(kg) × 给药强度(mg/kg)；单次剂量 = 日剂量: Algorithm: daily dose = weight (kg) × dose rate (mg/kg); single dose = daily dose ÷ doses per day. Weight, dose rate and doses per day must be >0; weight >300 kg or a dose rate >100 mg/kg triggers a double-check note. Follow medical advice for actual medication.
map.按体重给药剂量（本页代码口径）：日剂量=体重×剂量率（mg/天，体重 kg、剂量: Weight-based dosing (as implemented on this page): daily dose = weight × dose rate (mg/day, weight in kg, dose rate in mg/kg); single dose = daily dose ÷ doses per day (mg/dose), both rounded to 1 decimal place. Validation: weight, dose rate and doses per day must be >0; missing or non-positive input is flagged and the calculation stops; weight >300 kg or a dose rate >100 mg/kg adds a double-check note. Grading: no fixed grading; single dose is inversely proportional to doses per day, and the daily total always equals weight × dose rate.
